summary: auth-service pods OOMKILLed repeatedly after v2.3.1 deploy due to a memory leak in the session cache
root_cause: Memory leak in auth-service v2.3.1 session cache — entries were never evicted, causing gradual memory growth until OOMKill.
fix: Rolled back auth-service to v2.2.9 and applied a bounded LRU cache patch in v2.3.2.
